basis.governing_question: How should Seguros Atlântida redesign how its claims department is organized, roles and handoffs included?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Map claims work, roles and handoffs as they run today and agree design criteria with the client's leaders.

gate.label: Design scope decision
gate.decision: Which problem areas and design criteria does the Design phase take forward?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the target claims organization, covering structure, roles, handoffs and transition, ready for executive committee approval.

gate.label: Target model approval
gate.decision: Approve the target claims organization for submission to the executive committee?

workstreams.name: Claims organization today
workstreams.answers: How is the claims department organized today, in structure, roles and handoffs?
activities: Walk through claims steps with the people who do the work
Map structure, roles and handoffs as they run today
Collect operational data on claims volumes and workload

workstreams.name: Leaders' needs for claims
workstreams.answers: What do the Chief Operating Officer and Head of Claims need the new organization to fix and keep?
activities: Interview the Chief Operating Officer and Head of Claims
Interview claims staff on what works and what does not
Record what the new organization must fix and must keep

workstreams.name: Problem areas and criteria
workstreams.answers: Which problem areas in claims structure, roles and handoffs, and which design criteria, go into the Design phase?
activities: Rank problem areas using the mapping, interviews and data
Draft design criteria and agree them with the leaders
Propose which problem areas the Design phase takes forward

workstreams.name: Claims model options
workstreams.answers: Which options for claims structure, roles and handoffs should be compared, and against which design criteria?
activities: Draft options for claims structure, roles and handoffs
Compare the options against the agreed design criteria
Present the options at the design workshop for a choice

workstreams.name: Target claims organization
workstreams.answers: What does the chosen target claims organization look like in structure, roles, handoffs and governance?
activities: Detail structure, roles and governance of the chosen model
Design the handoffs between claims roles
Detail the design with the leaders of each claims unit

workstreams.name: Claims transition plan
workstreams.answers: What transition does the target claims organization need, and in what order do the changes happen?
activities: Identify what changes for each role and handoff
Sequence the changes needed to reach the target model
Test the sequence with the Head of Claims

workstreams.name: Target model sign-off
workstreams.answers: What must the executive committee see to approve the target claims organization?
activities: Review the target model and plan with both leaders
Resolve review comments in the design and plan
Assemble the material for executive committee approval

deliverables.name: Baseline of claims structure, roles and handoffs today
Interview synthesis of what claims must fix and keep
Problem areas and design criteria for the Design phase
Claims organization options compared with design criteria
Detailed design of the target claims organization
Transition roadmap and change plan for claims
Executive committee pack for target claims organization

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start the Diagnostic and agree data access
events.decision: Which claims data and people can the Diagnostic draw on from week 1?
agenda: Present the Diagnostic objective and the weeks 1 to 5 plan
Discuss the claims data and people the baseline needs
Align on who opens access to claims data and interviews

events.label: Check-in: first findings
events.purpose: Review the baseline and interview findings
events.decision: Is the evidence enough to start framing problem areas and design criteria?
agenda: Present the baseline of claims structure, roles and handoffs
Present the interview synthesis on what claims must fix and keep
Discuss gaps to close before problem areas are drafted

events.label: Design scope decision
events.purpose: Set what the Design phase takes forward
events.decision: Which problem areas and design criteria does the Design phase take forward?
agenda: Present the problem areas and design criteria for the Design phase
Review the baseline and interview findings behind them
Decide which areas and criteria the Design phase takes forward

events.label: Workshop 1: model options
events.purpose: Compare claims options against the criteria
events.decision: Which claims organization option goes forward to detailed design?
agenda: Present the claims organization options compared with design criteria
Discuss how each option handles structure, roles and handoffs
Decide which option goes forward to detailed design

events.label: Workshop 2: detailed design
events.decision: Go or no-go: take the detailed target design into transition planning?
agenda: Present the detailed design of the target claims organization
Review structure, roles and handoffs against the design criteria
Discuss what the transition plan has to cover

events.label: Target model approval
events.purpose: Approve the target model for submission
events.decision: Approve the target claims organization for submission to the executive committee?
agenda: Present the executive committee pack for the target claims organization
Review the transition roadmap and change plan for claims
Decide whether the target model goes to the executive committee

architect_notes: Engagement length is open: 14-17 weeks is an estimate; slow executive committee sign-off and a harder target model would push Design to its 13-week top.
The one claims department of about 140 people comes from public research and needs the client's confirmation, as it sets the Diagnostic length.
The executive committee approves the target model but is not in the stakeholders; confirm who represents it at the final gate.

sub_questions.question: How is the claims department organized today, in structure, roles and handoffs?
What do the Chief Operating Officer and Head of Claims need the new organization to fix and keep?
Which options for the claims structure, roles and handoffs should be compared, and against which criteria?
What does the chosen target organization look like in structure, roles, handoffs and governance?
What transition does the target organization need, and what must the executive committee see to approve it?

drivers.evidence: One claims department of about 140 people in Lisbon.

phases.name: Diagnostic

work.unit: Unit diagnosed (interviews, process walk-throughs, workload and cost baseline)

phases.why: One department diagnosed in one pass; interviews and process walk-throughs run together.

phases.name: Design

work.unit: Target model for the whole organization (structure, roles, governance)
Unit-level design detailed with the unit's leaders

phases.why: Target model, unit-level design, transition plan and client sign-off run in sequence; the sign-off cycle lifts the top above the typical 10 weeks.

sizing.levers: Running unit-level design and the transition plan side by side, or comparing fewer target model options, would shorten Design most.
